attempts.signature: Dispatcher exceeded the 90-second observation bound after all five layouts were approved
attempts.diagnosis: Harness awaited its own oldest queued job, while the product dispatcher owns ordering and single-worker slots; it could complete a different job. No job snapshot was retained by the original timeout handler.

comparison.hypothesis: Observe any actual committed completion, yield for slot release and include running jobs, rather than imposing SQL id order on the scheduler.
comparison.baseline: runtime-01.json, five approvals then observation timeout
comparison.success: Five executed/prepared packages observed through public HTTP; all in one area
comparison.stop: One replacement walk, 90 seconds per completion and at most 30 drain dispatches; retain queued/running/error snapshot on a timeout

attempts.decision: Change harness observation only; no product scheduler changes. Read processing.ts dispatchTick and intake-run.ts nextIntakeRunJob; their ordering is the authority. Own container removed and originals unchanged.

attempts.signature: Five drafted/prepared in one area, then commit job fails with STALE_REVISION
attempts.diagnosis: The job stores the refusal code, not its explanatory message. The harness incorrectly expected neighbours wording in jobs.error; it stopped before the prescribed individual confirmation recovery.
attempts.result: The bounded observation comparison succeeded: 5 drafts, 5 prepared, 1661 ready; drop-to-five-drafts 20821 ms. Stored NYC polygon fingerprint matches CA0.
attempts.decision: Read commitPackage's STALE_REVISION guard. Capture its words with one HTTP negative commit control, then use fresh HTTP review/confirmation for each remaining package. No area or worker edits.

attempts.signature: HTTP negative control returns exact LP1 words with a trailing full stop
attempts.diagnosis: The harness's exact string assertion omitted the full stop present in commitPackage. Five drafts/preparations and the negative control succeeded; recovery was not reached.
attempts.decision: Match the actual product words including punctuation, and retain the refusal. No product changes. Add the required labelled line author/approve/draft control before the final walk.

attempts.signature: Published review response lookup failed before the HTTP review request
attempts.diagnosis: intakeHttp defaults POST to 202 for confirmation commands; package review publishes 200. Initial LP1 code and exact words are now retained, and the three card jobs drained.
attempts.decision: Pass review's declared 200 explicitly. Audit all harness calls against their declared status before the next walk; no product changes.

attempts.signature: Fresh individual package review returns 422 AREA_LIMIT
attempts.diagnosis: area.areas.ts:1093 counts current observations plus candidate features and crossing neighbours together against 2000. The five NYC layers have 2362 accepted features, so LP1 is required for the prescribed recovery as well as the shared confirmation. The first individual recovery succeeded before a later review hit the cap.
attempts.decision: Do not change unowned areas or partition/omit source features. Record the cap as a blocked outcome, attempt each remaining bounded review once, and finish independent feet/line controls. No all-five-recorded or full gate claim.

attempts.result: Final scoped partial qualification: all five drafts/preparations; 1661 building targets recorded and 3 carded; fresh individual recovery records 3 non-building packages; one remains at AREA_LIMIT. Feet fixture parity and road-line author/approve/draft with building-line refusal pass.
attempts.decision: Finish KN2; report LP1 and the aggregate area cap. No full GF1/GF5 claim, no unowned changes. All six nonce-owned containers removed, zero providers, source hashes unchanged.
